notes.title: Monster Jam Steel Titans - 1.4.0 Titans Update
notes.content:
[h1]Titans Update[/h1]
v1.4.0

[h2]New Features and Content[/h2]
[b]Titan Challenges[/b]
Grave Digger, Max-D, and El Toro Loco wait for you in Monster Jam University! Compete in 12 Titan Challenge events designed to put your skills to the test. Unlock game-changing rewards by taking 1st Place in each event.

[b]Career Plus[/b]
Arena, Stadium, and Outdoor careers re-imagined at Steel Titan difficulty

[b]Overcast Monster Jam Trucks[/b]
Overcast variants of Grave Digger, Megalodon, and Dragon. Unlock each by placing Top 3 in a Career Plus.


[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]3/4 Camera
[*]Drone Camera
[*]Moved Split Screen to Main Menu
[*]Added more destructible objects
[*]Enhanced tire particles
[*]General AI improvements, especially in outdoor events
[*]Basic Steering Wheel controller configuration
[*]Added support for Shifter peripheral
[*]Added INI support for Steering Wheel controller mapping
[*]Added Restart option to Pause menu in Career
[*]Head-to-Head brackets are generated using current Standings in Career
[*]Improved stunt detection
[*]Reduced stunt exploits
[*]Improved performance in Timed Destruction and Free Ride
[*]Miscellaneous visual improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Monster Jam Steel Titans gets massive update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34572568/b81ea9427060c431e1bdc5813df1c324df1aae62.png[/img]

Vienna/Austria, Palmetto/Florida, December 13th, 2019 – Monster Jam Steel Titans is getting a MASSIVE update TODAY that includes enhanced gameplay features! The “Titans Update” is free to Monster Jam Steel Titans players and will expand upon the fan favorite title bringing more competition with a Career+ game mode; Monster Jam Overcast trucks; plus, fun and challenging new obstacles to find in the expansive open world.

Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xumwKwbrmg
Link to patch notes: https://www.monsterjamgame.com/titan-update/

[b]WHAT[/b]: A new patch that packs in new content from the Monster Jam universe and features requested directly by the Monster Jam fan community. Players can look forward to the expanded Career+ mode, Monster Jam Overcast trucks and new obstacles to find in the big open world, including boost pads, jumps, and loops.

[b]WHEN[/b]: NOW! Friday, December 13, 2019

[b]WHY[/b]: THQ Nordic and Rainbow Studios first entry into the Monster Jam video game series has been very popular with the extremely active Monster Jam fans. The Titans update delivers what these fans have been asking for and more!

[b]HOW[/b]: This update will happen automatically when the game is launched with an internet connection. Monster Jam Steel Titans is available for Xbox One, PlayStation 4™, Nintendo Switch™, and for PC.
	
Enjoy!
Your Rainbow Studios & THQ Nordic Team

notes.title: Monster Jam Steel Titans - 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.1.0

[h1]Fire & Ice Truck Bundle DLC[/h1]
[list]
[*]Team Fire: Megalodon Fire, Grave Digger Fire, Max-D Fire, Zombie Fire, Great Clips Mohawk Warrior Fire, Wildfire
[*]Team Ice: Dragon Ice, El Toro Loco Ice, Grave Digger Ice, Monster Mutt Dalmatian Ice, Soldier Fortune Ice, Yeti
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved interactions with containers and container ramps
[*]Improved interactions with large objects and other structures
[*]Player's truck audio no longer cuts out under specific circumstances
[*]Multiple fixes to prevent exiting play area
[*]Various fixes for other rare and unusual bugs
[/list]

[h1]Updates and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved and expanded force feedback on Wheel Controllers
[*]General improvements to truck audio, especially to First-Person experience
[*]Numerous small audio changes (crowd, collisions, environments, etc.)
[*]Minor performance improvements throughout, especially in Waypoint races
[/list]

notes.title: Monster Jam Steel Titans - Hotfix Patch 1.0.1 Notes
notes.content:
v1.0.1 Hotfix

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Flips no longer detected during Cyclones and Donuts
[*]Fixed rare crash in Truck Select menu
[*]Lessened rotational forces which could cause the truck to spin on front or rear ends
[/list]

[h1]Updates and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved Stunt Detection (Backflips and Frontflips, Wheelies and Stoppies, Slap Wheelies, Sky Wheelies)
[*]Minor adjustments to Basics Tutorial
[*]Various small improvements to Monster Jam University
[/list]
